hypothesis: Giving each of the 120 fit records approximately 100 optimizer exposures with the r34-accepted spectral-temporal architecture and constant 1e-3 learning rate will reduce low-resolution train-only calibration relative L2 below 0.5.
expected_mechanism: r34 required roughly 100 same-record updates to approach 0.1; r35 stopped after only six exposures per record. Exposure matching should reveal whether the architecture transfers propagation structure across records once optimization is not prematurely truncated.
primary_metric: best low-resolution train-only calibration relative L2
failure_signal: Calibration relative L2 above 0.5 after 100 exposures, non-finite prediction, OOM, missing checkpoint, or binding failure rejects exposure insufficiency without opening confirmation or project validation/test_id.
rollback: Preserve r34-r36 and all prior artifacts; if rejected, add explicit medium/source conditioning or a learned propagator prior under a new train-only preregistration.
